libp2p is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2018.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (3).

Most recently: [bcnode-extra-scripts](@/work/bcnode-extra-scripts.md): BC Extra Scripts (DX); [js-libp2p-umbrella](@/work/js-libp2p-umbrella.md): Umbrella repository for j2-libp2p and relavant modules; [bcnode-old](@/work/bcnode-old.md): Mining node with built-in block rover and DHT.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses libp2p: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links libp2p to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
